TSD S8 T5.2 names the published interfaces without an operation name, so no name may be invented, and the plan's C row for this slice is empty, so the three rows are C dependencies in fact and not in the metadata.

No Temporal cell links S8 to a route service, so this service pauses no stage timer itself.
why: TSD S8 T4 gives the 22 rules over 9 states of the DEVIATION machine, FSD S8 A2.2 and A2.3 put the stage clock and the prescription clock on the case, and the connection matrix gives S8 a Temporal cell only to P10 and receives a Temporal cell from P3. The legacy text 'the case moves to DEV_REROUTE' therefore becomes an answer, and the pause stays with the service that owns the timers.
